label: prop:reeb-operations-per-planck
title: Discrete iterations per Reeb circuit
html:
Let q \in k^\times \setminus \{1\}. Let t_P(q) = q/(q-1) be the Planck time (Planck time). The number of discrete f_q-iterations (evaluations of f_q(z) = z^2 + c(q) on the exceptional divisor) comprising one Reeb circuit is

  n_R(q) =  t_P(q) =  \frac{q}{q - 1} =  \frac{1}{\hbar_q}.

Each iteration executes one braiding evaluation (a single R-matrix application) and one jet prolongation step. Together, these advance the phase by exactly the fraction \hbar_q of a full circuit.
